description: MT Form 2 page 2: taxable income $50,000 with $20,000 of net long-term capital gains. Ordinary income is 30,000, which exceeds the $21,100 threshold, so line 6 is zero and ALL the gain is taxed at 4.1% = $820 (line 11); ordinary tax on 30,000 = 5.9% x 30,000 - 253 = $1,517 (line 12); line 13 = $2,337.
